name: Botman
tagline: Case-files the strangers trying to reach your social accounts
description: A detective-themed guard for your social accounts. It reviews new followers and message requests, flags likely scams, bot accounts and impersonators, and writes a short case file for each suspect. It also summarises publicly reported local crime activity, and carries a seasonal Halloween mode for parents.
author: Rune_King_Jake
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
